pages.quiz:
ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the Library
   B. Where is the library
   C. where is the library
   D. Where is the library?

2. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. No full stops
   B. Many unrelated topics with no link
   C. One main idea with supporting sentences
   D. Only one word repeated

3. When practising Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Handwriting.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Handwriting.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Handwriting.

4. When practising Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.

5. When practising Attentive Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Attentive Listening.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive Listening.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Attentive Listening.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive Listening.

6. When practising Language Activities at home, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Language Activities at home.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Language Activities at home.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Activities at home.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Language Activities at home.

7. When practising Spelling, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Spelling.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Spelling.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Spelling.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Spelling.

8. When practising Guided Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Guided Writing.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Guided Writing.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Guided Writing.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Guided Writing.

9. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. quickly
   B. happiness
   C. run
   D. blue

10. When practising Connected text and fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Connected text and fluency.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Connected text and fluency.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text and fluency.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Connected text and fluency.

11. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only a joining word
   B. Only an action
   C. A person, place, thing, or idea
   D. Only a describing word

12. When practising Word Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Word Reading.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Word Reading.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word Reading.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Word Reading.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Language Activities at home and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Handwriting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Spelling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Where is the library?

2. C — One main idea with supporting sentences

3. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.

4. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.

5. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive Listening.

6. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Activities at home.

7. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Spelling.

8. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Guided Writing.

9. C — run

10. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text and fluency.

11. C — A person, place, thing, or idea

12. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word Reading.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Language Activities at home; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Comprehension; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Handwriting; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Spelling; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
